title: Florida wants a court to stop ChatGPT from pretending to be human and talking to kids
summary: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier is asking a court to ban OpenAI from giving ChatGPT human-like traits and marketing it to minors. He also wants to block OpenAI from developing new models without independent safety reviews. OpenAI said it has paused training of its most capable models.
